title: Creamy Udon Noodle Soup
description: A comforting and easy-to-make soup perfect for a chilly evening. This recipe combines the smoothness of molten ingredients with the richness of French flavors.

ingredients.name: mushroom broth
ingredients.notes: you can use store-bought or homemade

ingredients.name: milk
ingredients.notes: or substitute with cream for a richer soup

ingredients.name: melted butter
ingredients.notes: or use oil for a lighter option

ingredients.name: salt
ingredients.notes: be mindful of the sodium in the broth

instructions: Heat the butter in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the French onion soup mix and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Pour in the mushroom broth and bring to a boil.
Add the udon noodles and cook according to package instructions, usually 8-10 minutes.
Stir in the milk and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until heated through.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped herbs or a sprinkle of parmesan cheese.
Optional: add some grated French cheese, such as gruyère or comté, for an extra burst of flavor.
